_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-06-30 · Session 87 (StarMax) · the population sub-activity cards now match the KPI breakdown, and the MAP Users management tab is live end-to-end
_status: Two things shipped today. (A) CARD FIX (PR #617): the Working Adults / Veterans / Apprentice cards on Goal 2 were showing stale numbers — they're now wired to the live STUDENTS-SERVED breakdown, so 3.1.1/3.1.2/3.1.2a (23,388 / 24,864 / 753) match the headline by construction, just like 3.1 and 3.2. (B) MAP USERS TAB (PRs #618–#621): a new gated 'MAP Users' tab manages MAP's per-college user roster (2,741 staff across 128 colleges) — everyone sees per-college counts + the role mix; signed-in reviewers see the names/emails; and a 📣 nudge opens a pre-filled email to a college's Primary Contact + VP of Instruction + VP of Student Services asking them to refresh their users. Staff PII lives only in a gated database, never in the repo.

items.text: Glance at Goal 2: the Working Adults (3.1.1), Veterans & Service (3.1.2), and Apprentice (3.1.2a) cards should now show live numbers that match the STUDENTS-SERVED breakdown on the headline card (no more stale 21,552 / 22,149 / 700). Flag if any still look off.
